description: Source code for the GLEntry class and related functions in the ERPNext accounting module, handling general ledger entries including validation, updates, and renaming.

classes.name: GLEntry
classes.description: Represents a General Ledger Entry with methods for validation, naming, and related operations.

methods.name: autoname
methods.description: Generates a temporary unique name for the document for fast insertion.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs various validation checks before saving the document.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Handles operations to perform after the document is updated, including validation and updating outstanding amounts.

methods.name: check_mandatory
methods.description: Ensures required fields are filled and validates account type and debit/credit amounts.

methods.name: pl_must_have_cost_center
methods.description: Validates that P&L accounts have a cost center.

methods.name: validate_dimensions_for_pl_and_bs
methods.description: Validates mandatory dimensions for Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet accounts.

methods.name: validate_allowed_dimensions
methods.description: Checks if dimensions conform to allowed or restricted values.

methods.name: check_pl_account
methods.description: Ensures P&L accounts are not used in opening entries.

methods.name: validate_account_details
methods.description: Validates that the account is ledger, active, and belongs to the correct company.

methods.name: validate_cost_center
methods.description: Validates the cost center's existence and association with the company.

methods.name: validate_currency
methods.description: Ensures the transaction currency matches account currency and party currency.

methods.name: validate_and_set_fiscal_year
methods.description: Sets the fiscal year if not already set.
